chapter.verse: Sabbath ni khat, Pharisee ulian khat' inn ah anne dingin Jesu a pai leh mite in amah naitak encik uh hi.
Tua laitak, en un, cibawk natna nei mi khat Jesu' mai-ah om hi.
Jesu in thukhun hilhcian syate leh Pharisee-te' kiangah, "Sabbath ni-in cina damsak ding, phaltheih ahi hiam, hilo hiam?" ci-in dong hi.
Ahih hangin amaute daicip uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in, "No teng lakah a ta ahi-a a bawng ahi zongin Sabbath ni khatin tuikhuk dum sungah kia hileh thakhatin a kaito pah lo ding kua om na hi uh hiam?" ci hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in hih thute dawng theilo uh hi.
Tu-in mithupite' tutna mun teng mite in a teel uh a muh ciangin Jesu in amaute' kiangah thugenteh khat gen hi:
"Mi khatpeuh in mopawi ah hong khoh ciangin mithupite' tutna mun ah tu kei in. A hang pen inntekpa in nang sangin a thupizaw mi zong na kho theikha ding a,
na nihun hong khokhawm tua inntekpa hong pai ciangin, 'Na tutna amah awn in,' hong ci leh a niampen mun ah maizumna tawh na tut kul ding hi.

Tua hi a, pawi ah hong kikhoh ciangin a niampen mun ah pai-in tuzaw in. Tua hileh inntekpa hong pai ciangin, 'Lawm aw, a sangzaw mun ah hong kituah in,' hong ci ding hi. Tua ciangin nang tawh a tukhawm mite khempeuh' mai-ah na maitaang ding hi.
A hang pen amahmah a kisanglap khempeuh kiniamkoih ding a, amahmah a kiniamkhiatte kisanglap ding hi."

Jesu in amah a kho inntekpa zong hih bangin hopih hi: "Anvakna ahihkeileh pawi lianpi na bawl ciangin na lawmte, na sanggamte, na tanaute leh na veng mihaute kho kei in. A hang pen amau zong nang hong kho-in siamthuk na ngah ding hi.
Tua ahih manin pawi na bawl ciangin mizawngte, khezawte, khelbaite leh khuamulote kho in.
Tua hileh amaute in siam hong thuk zolo ding uh a, nang pen thuphangah na hiding hi. A hang pen midikte' thawhkik hun ciangin siamthuh na ngah ding hi."
Jesu tawh ankuang uumkhawmte lakah khat in hih thute a zak ciangin Jesu' kiangah, "Pasian' kumpigam ah anlum a ne ding mi khempeuh thuphangah ahi hi," ci hi.
Ahi zongin Jesu in hih bangin ci hi: "Khatvei, mi khat in pawi lianpi bawlin mi tampi sam hi.
Pawi hun a tun ciangin a khohsa mite kiangah, 'Hong pai un, na khempeuh a baihsa-in om ta hi,' a va ci dingin a silapa sawl hi.
Ahih hangin tua mite a vekun paulap zong tek uh a, a masapenpa in, 'Lo ciing khat ka lei khin a, ka va etloh phamawh hi. Nong theihsiam ding kong thum hi,' ci hi.
A nihnapa in, 'Bawngtal kap nga ka lei khin a, ka va ettel kul ding hi. Nong theihsiam ding kong thum hi,' ci hi.
A thumnapa in, 'Zi nei khin phet ka hih manin kong pai thei kei ding hi,' ci hi.

Tua ciangin silapa hong ciahin a topa' kiangah a thu teng ko hi. Inntekpa heh ta ahih manin a silapa' kiangah, 'Khuasung lamzikpi leh konglak lampi teng ah manlang va pai inla mizawngte, khezawte, khuamulote leh khelbaite hong paipih in,' ci hi.
Silapa in, 'Topa aw, nong thupiak teng ka sem khin a, ahi zongin mun omlai veve hi,' ci hi.
Tua ciangin a topa in a silapa' kiangah, 'Ka inn a dim nadingin khuapua lamzikpite leh lonawl lamneute ah va pai unla zawhthawh thu tawh mite hong lutsak un.
A hang pen ke'n kong cihin ah ka khoh mite khat nangawn in ka pawi an ciamkha lo ding uh hi,' ci-in thupia hi."
Tu-in mihonpi in Jesu zui uh ahih manin Jesu kihei-in amaute' kiangah hih bangin ci hi:
"Mi khatpeuh kei hong zuan napi a pa, a nu, a zi, a tate, a sanggampate, a sanggamnute, tua banah ama' nuntakna nangawn, a nununsak keileh keima' nungzui suak theilo ding hi.
Ama' singlamteh pua lo pi-in kei hong zui peuhmah keima' nungzui suak theilo ding hi.
A hang pen note lakah tausang a lam nuam khat in zawhsiang nading sum a kicingin a neih a neihloh a theih nadingin tusukin a beizah a sehgawm masa lo ding kua om na hi uh hiam?
Tuat kei henla khuambul a phuh khit ciangin zosiang zolo hileh a mu khempeuh in amah zahpih nuihin,
Hih mipa inn lam ding kipan napi zosiang zolo hi,' ci ding uh hi.

Ahihkeileh zong kumpi khat in kumpi dang khat tawh gal kido ding a kuankhiat ciangin galkap then nih tawh hong kuanpa, galkap then khat tawh ka do zo ding hiam, cih tusuk masa-in lungngai phot ding hilo ahi hiam?
Do zolo ding ahihleh galsimpa hong tun ding gamlapi a sap laitak palai beelpawl khat sawlin kilem nading thum ding hi.
Tua hi a, note lakah a neih teng a vekin a nusia lo peuhmah keima' nungzui suak theilo ding hi.
"Ci pen hoih a, ahi zongin tua ci pen a alna bei leh bangci bangin ki-alsakkik thei ding hiam?
Leitang' ading hitaleh, leihoihza' ading hitaleh kimanna om lo ahih manin paih ding hi lel hi. Zak nading bil a neite in za ta hen."Tuu Mangthang Thugenteh
